finalText:
**Found it: double rounding.**

`computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` rounded to 2 decimals after the percent discount, and again after the flat discount, both in USD, before converting to the order's currency. Those intermediate roundings threw away fractions of a cent that should have carried through to the final currency conversion — so any cart with a percent coupon (alone or stacked with a flat one) came out a cent low, and yen carts a full yen low.

Fixed it to only round once, at the very end, in the target currency's own decimal places — matching what finance expects.

All 40 pricing-matrix tests pass now (`node --test`, was 10 failing).
